summary: TSMC filed a Form 6-K reporting resolutions passed at its 2026 Annual Shareholders Meeting, including acknowledgment of the 2025 business report and financial statements (revenue NT$3,809.05B, net income NT$1,717.88B, diluted EPS NT$66.25) and approval of amendments to its Articles of Incorporation. This is a routine foreign private issuer report of ordinary meeting results, not a special situation. No transaction, activist event, strategic review, or corporate action is involved. As a foreign issuer filing under Rule 13a-16, the 6-K is the equivalent of a US Form 8-K for material events, but the content is purely routine governance. There is no deal, recommendation, advisor, or structural feature to analyze.
